tickets.title: V3.9.5 Conversation: add inferred conversation mode classifier
tickets.description: Add deterministic inferred conversation modes for chat prompt assembly. Modes: status, planning, exploration, debug, diagnostics, bug, casual. No visible UI toggle. Keep the classifier simple, inspectable, and covered by unit tests.
acceptance: Common user phrasings classify into status, planning, exploration, debug, diagnostics, bug, or casual
Prompt assembly includes the detected mode and expected answer shape
Classifier is deterministic and does not call a live model
Tests cover representative phrasings including quick status, planning, bug report, diagnostics, and casual chat
No UI toggle or new frontend control is added

tickets.title: V3.9.5 Conversation: add response depth controller
tickets.description: Add a deterministic response depth controller for brief, standard, and deep answers. Default to standard; use deep for planning/exploration; use brief for status, check, and update asks.
acceptance: Depth values are limited to brief, standard, and deep
Status/check/update asks select brief by default
Planning and exploration asks select deep by default
Prompt assembly includes selected depth and answer-length expectations
Tests verify that 'what changed?' is brief while 'thoughts on V4?' can be deep

tickets.title: V3.9.5 Conversation: trim personality prompt toward co-founder voice
tickets.description: Refine _personality_prompt() so Crowley is warm, opinionated, useful, and less theatrical while preserving the identity that Crowley is the running system.
acceptance: Personality prompt keeps Crowley as the running system, not a generic assistant
Prompt favors project co-founder behavior: useful, direct, warm, and willing to have a point of view
Prompt avoids excessive flourish and long answers when the controller requests brief output
Diagnostics prompt does not inherit the co-founder chat tone
Deterministic tests or fixtures cover the relevant prompt text

tickets.title: V3.9.5 Conversation: keep diagnostics tone separate from chat tone
tickets.description: Ensure diagnostics stays factual, structured, and SQL/fact-first instead of inheriting exploration or co-founder chat tone.
acceptance: Diagnostics prompt remains factual and structured
Diagnostics prompt does not include chat mode/depth/personality flourish
Diagnostics still uses gathered SQL/system facts as the authority
Tests verify diagnostics prompt separation from chat prompt assembly
No diagnostics data writes are introduced

tickets.title: V3.9.5 Conversation: add model behavior regression fixtures
tickets.description: Add deterministic regression fixtures around prompt assembly, mode/depth selection, diagnostics separation, and representative user prompts. Do not test live model quality.
acceptance: Tests cover mode selection for representative prompts
Tests cover depth selection for quick status versus deep planning
Tests cover prompt assembly includes mode, depth, and answer shape
Tests cover diagnostics separation
No test depends on a live OpenAI or Ollama response

tickets.title: V3.9.5 Conversation: sweep confirmed chat UX bugs
tickets.description: Fix confirmed chat UX bugs only: empty/model-error states, slash-command rejection clarity, and streaming completion/error handling. Avoid new feature scope.
acceptance: Empty chat/model-error cases present a clear user-facing state
Unsupported slash commands are rejected clearly
Streaming completion and streaming error paths leave the UI in a usable state
Tests cover each fixed bug where practical
No unrelated chat feature or provider-routing change is added

tickets.title: V3.9.6 Workspace Polish: add loading/error/empty states
tickets.description: Add consistent loading, error, and empty states for chat, Intelligence panels, ticket detail, Agent Feed, Memory, and diagnostics. Prioritize no blank or dead panels.
acceptance: Chat, ticket detail, Agent Feed, Memory, and diagnostics have visible loading/error/empty states
Panel states use existing visual language and do not create a redesign
Offline or failed fetch states are understandable
Empty tickets/activity/memory states are not blank
Focused UI/static tests cover the state helpers or rendered state text

tickets.title: V3.9.6 Workspace Polish: smooth chat streaming states
tickets.description: Improve chat streaming feel without changing model provider logic. Make streaming start, token flow, completion, and error behavior clear and stable.
acceptance: User sees a clear in-progress state when streaming begins
Partial token flow remains stable and does not duplicate final text
Completion clears loading state reliably
Streaming errors show a recoverable error state
No model provider or backend routing behavior is changed

tickets.title: V3.9.6 Workspace Polish: tighten navigation and panel flow
tickets.description: Tighten Intelligence drawer navigation, selected ticket detail behavior, and panel switching so tabs feel predictable and detail views do not flicker unnecessarily.
acceptance: Intelligence tab switching preserves expected selected state
Ticket detail selection is stable across refreshes where practical
Panel switching does not flash blank content unnecessarily
Mobile-ish widths remain usable
Focused tests or static checks cover changed state/render behavior

tickets.title: V3.9.6 Workspace Polish: add clear what changed feed
tickets.description: Make recent changes obvious from existing agent activity, ticket events, and handoff data so Mr. Go can see what Cursor/Codex changed recently without reading raw handoffs.
acceptance: Workspace exposes a clear recent-changes surface using existing data
Feed includes recent Cursor/Codex work, ticket status changes, and handoff-linked activity where available
Feed avoids raw handoff dumps when a concise summary exists
Empty/error/loading states are handled
No new external collector or direct agent channel is introduced

tickets.title: V3.9.6 Workspace Polish: frontend livability pass
tickets.description: Fix obvious frontend friction: spacing, overflow, mobile-ish width issues, and dead affordances. Keep scope to livability, not redesign.
acceptance: Obvious text overflow and cramped layout issues are fixed
Common panels remain usable at desktop and mobile-ish widths
Dead or misleading affordances are removed, disabled, or clarified
Existing visual style is preserved
Manual browser QA notes identify the checked views

tickets.title: V3.9.6 Workspace Polish: final docs and version lock
tickets.description: Lock V3.9.5 and V3.9.6 as shipped once implementation tickets pass review. Add release docs and update WHERE_WE_ARE, PROJECT_STATE, ROADMAP, TICKETS, VERSIONS, and knowledge files as needed so V4 starts from current truth.
acceptance: V3.9.5 and V3.9.6 release docs reflect what actually shipped
WHERE_WE_ARE, PROJECT_STATE, ROADMAP, TICKETS, and VERSIONS are synchronized
Version constants are bumped only at the final lock step
V4 readiness gate clearly shows remaining blockers or confirms ready
Full regression suite passes before final approval
